text:
Sam: Handoff — I'm primary for the next 8h (US-west). Quick state: earlier P1 partially mitigated — kv-cache tier is flaky, we've routed critical traffic to CPU-fallback replicas. Leaving notes below.
incident-bot: [P1-17382] Created at 1738203000 — kvcache fallback detected: increased 99p latency and kvcache-misses.
Priya: Thanks — what's current customer impact? Any open alerts?
Sam: Customer impact: Search latency >2s for ~4% of requests, some 500s for rerank. Affected customers: Acme, Brightside — support tickets filed. Autoretry causing spike in downstream qps. Metrics snapshot: kvcache-hitrate down to 62% (normal ~98%).
Maria: Runbook link and playbook?
Sam: Runbook: <https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-fallback|kvcache fallback runbook>. Key steps:
1) validate node health (kubectl get pods -l app=kvcache),
2) scale read-only replicas,
3) apply iptables blackhole for bad nodes,
4) shift traffic using routing toggle.
Sam: ```
# quick health check
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=kvcache -o wide
curl -sS http://kvcache-metrics:9090/metrics | grep kvcache_hits
```
Jordan: Any temporary mitigation we should do before waking infra? Also who to page if we need to escalate to SRE infra team?
Sam: Escalation matrix: page Priya (primary infra) for immediate action, then Jordan for routing if Priya unavailable, then @oncall-phone (eng-infra pager group). If customer impact increases to >10% or >30m unresolved with p99>3s, escalate to PagerDuty policy 'redwood-p1-escalation' (phone + sms).
Priya: I can take infra lead. I'll check logs and health. If any node shows OOM or repeated socket errors, we failover and drain node.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered at 1738208800 for kvcache-release v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0
Sam: Note: We rolled back canary at 17:40 UTC. Remaining tasks: rewarm caches and monitor KV warmup progress. Expected increased cost due to CPU fallback; watch 'infra-cost-spike' alerts (threshold 20%).
Maria: During handoff, primary/secondary: Sam primary, Priya secondary for infra, Jordan secondary for routing. Next shift primary is Maria (starts 1738230000). Add to runbook: who to page, bridge link.
Jordan: If we need to open an incident bridge, use #inc-bridge-2 and run `/incident open P1 kvcache`. Keep eng-oncall updated + create a thread for customer comms.
Priya: I'll update the runbook with node IDs and retention logs. If vendor escalation is required (Redis Labs), page #vendors-redis with 'urgent'.
Sam: Wrapping up: leaving as primary until 1738212000 UTC. Checklist for incoming: - confirm alerts quieting (<5m no p99 spike) - confirm failing nodes drained - confirm no new tickets from Acme/Brightside - handover SLA notes
Sam: Handoff complete — transferring primary to Maria in 30m unless escalated. :white_check_mark:
